goal.en: Implement one selected frontend creation, refinement or defect repair by reconciling the full draws image array, business intent, architecture and current source, then verify the actual rendered result.

sideEffects: reuse or create selected visual assets inside the owned frontend asset paths using available authorized tools

graphPolicy.location: .work node dependsOn/refs with direct sourceRefs and collocated assets

purpose.en: Read the existing selected N/index.yaml, ancestor scope, declared refs/dependencies/assertions and validator freshness. This consumer op requires its target node to exist. An absent target is a scope/graph gap: report it and propose a separately selected scope op; do not create a target or invent its acceptance/graph here.

Read accepted requirements, decisions, constraints and acceptance IDs declared as relevant inputs in the selected .work graph. Intent governs expected behavior; source is not a replacement. Do not invent a mandatory BA predecessor for a scope that does not require one; a needed missing input is a reported graph/scope gap, not a new dependency silently added here.

Read data ownership, operations/API/events, boundaries, code-scope and rationale declared by the selected .work graph; distinguish proposed paths from observed files. No universal architecture-first op chain is implied; report genuinely missing required scope before proceeding.

When source exists/is selected, resolve repository resource, actual checkout/root/HEAD and dirty state; read applicable instructions, manifests, owning code, callers and relevant tests. Greenfield/spec-only work records source not-yet-created and grounds intent in the user request; no invented repository or fact citation. Source implementation still needs an actual selected writable repository.

reads.path: knowledge/INDEX.json + applicable FE, UI composition/presentation/proof and selected family topics

purpose.en: Read applicable English knowledge topics and record actual rule IDs/cases and their scope. Verify family-specific rules against installed components and repository policy. Accepted draw assets do not waive applicable knowledge: implementation and render comparison must satisfy both; expose conflicts and their owner instead of silently copying a violating image, changing accepted design or weakening rules.

reads.path: selected defect evidence manifest + actual assets when repair is selected

purpose.en: For repairs, inspect the original failing assertion and source/runtime revision; reproduce or corroborate it on the current source before changing code. For new implementation record not applicable without inventing a defect.

reads.path: selected UI node index.yaml + its owned assets/*

purpose.en: Receive draws as one ordered array of actual image references, including a one-image array when only one image is supplied; never treat a single scalar or a caption as the array. Resolve each supplied image from its attachment, local asset or existing design resource without requiring the user to author metadata. Open and visually inspect every image. Record a stable reference, source revision/hash when available, screen, state, viewport and role for each entry in the input map; infer only observable mappings and label unknowns. The selected array is not an alternatives vote: unclear alternatives, approval or contradictory images require a scoped decision. Preserve every entry and its relation to other images; never use only the first image or silently omit inconvenient states. An empty array is allowed only when the selected scope explicitly has no draw input; a missing required array or unreadable image blocks the affected piece. Canonical design refs/files must already be declared where required by the selected graph; report a binding gap rather than changing the graph.

reads.path: selected UI node index.yaml + its owned assets/*

purpose.en: Read the actual installed component API/tokens and accepted surface/direction/state map; only require a separate visual direction if this task selected one.
Read exact target/origins, owner, configuration revision, declared probes and allowed effects; validate live observations without inferring identity from hostname alone.

reads.path: selected workflow request + workflows/contracts.json + this op authority.json

purpose.en: When selected inside the named workflow, read the exact request, strict response contract and primary/secondary authority JSON. Standalone op execution does not invent a workflow request.

Only when explicitly selected in a job matrix, read the exact cell ID, operation, immutable input bindings, requested output JSON shapes and required criteria. Standalone execution needs no fabricated matrix request. A template is not authority for extra effects.

reads.path: profiles/registry.json + selected runtime execution profile + actual host tools/model

purpose.en: Select the actual host runtime codex or claude and this operator role from the V2-derived active profiles. Use current host model configuration; historical model names are not availability proof. Capabilities are the intersection of actual tools, selected profile policy, op permissions and existing task authority. Do not revive V2 dispatch chains, retired profiles or extra-agent permissions.

reads.path: all input draws + selected repository assets/design system + authorized source assets

purpose.en: Inspect every image for icons, logos, photos, illustrations, textures and backgrounds. Find actual reusable source assets first; verify fidelity, ownership, permitted use, variants and source path. A screenshot is a design reference, not automatically a reusable production asset. Do not fabricate asset URLs or silently omit artwork.

content.en: Read the existing selected scope, expected assertions and .work graph unchanged. Write only state/blocker/completion here; actual observations, findings, commit mappings and remaining cleanup belong to the evidence result, not semantic node prose. Missing refs/dependencies/acceptance require a reported gap or separately selected scope update; never add/remove them to obtain pass.
Only exact owned paths in the approved code-scope, with smallest required caller/integration changes; record actual diff and commit mapping, not proposed changes as delivered.

Retain one draws-review entry per input image with its stable reference, observed screen/state/viewport, inspection result, linked implementation/captures and unresolved gaps; account for every array entry, including explicit non-applicable references with reasons. Retain an input map linking all accepted draws and their regions, business ACs, architecture/API/state contracts and actual source paths; record the applicable knowledge rule IDs/cases, per-rule observations, unresolved conflicts and visual deviations. For repairs retain the original failure, cause, smallest owned repair and before/after regression against unchanged expectations. Retain real test output and screenshot from the implemented surface, actually opened/inspected. Include viewport/theme, observed route/state, driver, served build and limitations; no fixture screenshot labelled product proof. Operator-specific observed result in E/result.md: Map delivered components/routes/client calls to ACs and state coverage; record actual source revision separately from served render revision. This implement op owns lint, typecheck, relevant tests/coverage, affected builds and Sonar. Resolve real repository scripts and CI thresholds; record command, source tree/commit, result and sanitized logs. For Sonar record the analysis/revision and actual server quality-gate result after processing; scanner submission alone is not pass. Fix scoped failures and rerun affected checks. A missing runner, token reference, coverage target or unavailable required Sonar gate is blocked/not-run, never pass; do not move this responsibility to architecture, business or UAT. Reuse existing authorization and keep secrets outside evidence.

Only for the selected named workflow, emit the response defined by workflows/contracts.json. Return outputs.flows in the original journey order, preserving business actions/expectations and adding actual sourcePaths; return full codeRefs including accepted backend support commits and the verified rendered runtime. These outputs become UAT inputs unchanged. A failed/blocked response preserves evidence with outputs:null.

Always return the FE handoff JSON, including standalone execution: flows with stable id/title/entry/actor/preconditions, ordered steps {id,action,expected,uxChecks}, cleanup obligations and actual sourcePaths; full codeRefs and observed runtime. Resolve actions and expected results from accepted business scope without weakening them. This is input for uat.verify, not a UAT pass. Use workflows/contracts.json output shape; missing accepted behavior blocks readiness. Include the complete asset manifest; pending decorative artwork stays explicitly deferred. Validate with the selected execution profile and complete input draw IDs.

Only for a selected job matrix, return the exact request-bound result. Populate every declared cell output with actual canonical Work/source/runtime references or produced JSON artifacts from this job; retain real artifact bytes and hashes. Do not rename/regenerate upstream expectations. Missing required output/evidence remains blocked or failed and cannot advance. The selected request freezes output field schemas before execution.

Emit the full asset inventory and link ready files to source paths and actual retained image artifacts. Reuse matching existing assets; otherwise generate/create and inspect them with the actual permitted instrument, then integrate dimensions, responsive variants, alt text and loading behavior. For Claude without image generation, keep decorative slots blank with stable layout, no broken/empty src, and a deferred brief {prompt,width,height,format,placement,placeholder:blank-reserved-slot}. Deferred files/artifacts are null, never generated. Do not defer an asset necessary for business/UX acceptance; retain that unmet criterion. When replacing deferred assets later, update source, manifest, commit and affected render checks.

action.en: Collect the selected scope, business ACs, architecture/API contracts, current source and applicable knowledge. Validate draws as an array and open every image; index each by actual screen/state/viewport and source identity in draws-review and the input map. Resolve shared layouts, responsive variants, sequential states and ambiguous alternatives explicitly. For repairs reproduce the original defect and preserve its evidence. Own preparation through delivery: inspect readiness and reproduce the requested defect when applicable, partition the selected work into cohesive changes and check callers before editing. Resolve repository-local dependencies and bounded development runtime needs under the existing scope. Shared library changes belong to the actual FE or BE package owner: include owner tests, packaging/export compatibility and selected consumer integration proof in this same implementation; never publish a package implicitly. Keep shared paths exclusive and report a missing required external authority rather than inventing a helper. For a landing surface, implement the accepted content, section sequence, assets and responsive interaction in the selected frontend source. Draw is only needed when the request requires a new visual decision; do not add a mandatory planning predecessor. Resolve the execution profile and actual tool availability before selecting instruments; this does not switch the model/runtime or spawn workers.

Map every relevant region across all draws to routes, shared/owned components, API reads/actions, states, ACs and actual knowledge rules/cases. Business governs behavior; images express accepted visual intent within applicable knowledge and installed component constraints. Record missing screens/states and cross-image or knowledge conflicts; do not average incompatible alternatives, invent behavior from pictures or weaken the selected graph.

Implement the mapped screens and shared layout once using actual installed components, tokens and repository conventions. Apply scoped creation, refinement or the smallest defect repair; retain cross-image consistency, responsive behavior, keyboard and focus. Follow applicable knowledge even where literal image copying would violate it; unresolved material design conflicts remain blocked. Account for every asset visible in every input draw. Reuse a verified matching asset or create/generate the required asset, inspect it and integrate its actual source file. Claude with no image-generation capability may reserve a blank decorative slot with a deferred brief; never use invented URLs, broken images or label pending art complete. Functional asset requirements remain blocking. Record E/assets.json even when the reviewed draws need no distinct assets. Write the frontend source summary only to implementation/frontend/index.yaml. Store only running-page screenshots in implementation/frontend/assets; design PNGs remain in ui/assets and UAT captures remain with their flow.

Connect actual data reads/actions, validation, permissions and navigation for the mapped journeys. Implement applicable loading, empty, error, denied, success and recovery states from the accepted business/API contracts, including required states not depicted in draws. Never guess endpoints, fake success or invent undisclosed business decisions. CALL POINT (step 4): if an observed API integration or render-data defect blocks an already accepted journey and is repairable without business changes, read interface.implement/secondary.json and call its listed backend.implement role. Pass the exact backend repository, allowed file paths, defect evidence/problem, changeKind and unchanged businessRefs. Set FE to waiting in this same cell. If no such defect exists, skip this call. If the repair needs business/schema/authorization changes or an unlisted operator, return blocked with the missing decision. Resume this step only after every required support response matches its request and passes every required criterion in the caller-owned secondary.json, including scope, business preservation, API compatibility, implementation quality and commit verification; inspect returned changes, integrate the actual commits and continue to step 5. Defects discovered in steps 5 or 6 return to this call point under the same permissions; never create an implicit helper.

Run relevant component/unit, interaction, type, lint and build checks for mapped ACs/states and applicable knowledge. For repairs retain before/after evidence for the original unchanged expected assertion plus collateral regressions. Fix only within scope; keep failed or untested required behavior visible. This implement op owns lint, typecheck, relevant tests/coverage, affected builds and Sonar. Resolve real repository scripts and CI thresholds; record command, source tree/commit, result and sanitized logs. For Sonar record the analysis/revision and actual server quality-gate result after processing; scanner submission alone is not pass. Fix scoped failures and rerun affected checks. A missing runner, token reference, coverage target or unavailable required Sonar gate is blocked/not-run, never pass; do not move this responsibility to architecture, business or UAT. Reuse existing authorization and keep secrets outside evidence.

Bind an authorized preview and observed served build. Open the implemented screens, drive relevant controls and capture every required screen/state/viewport represented by draws plus other required acceptance states. Open the captures and compare each mapped draw with its corresponding rendered evidence and applicable knowledge rules. Record coverage per input image and all deviations; no representative screenshot may stand in for unobserved screens. Repair within scope and recheck affected tests/captures before passing.

Review the owned diff and complete draws/AC/state/rule coverage; account for every input image and preserve justified out-of-scope limitations without silently dropping requirements. Record actual code commits when authorized, tested/served revisions, evidence and remaining gaps. Complete only when required implementation and rendered proof pass. Independent full UAT remains separate; stop. For workflow execution, Return outputs.flows in the original journey order, preserving business actions/expectations and adding actual sourcePaths; return full codeRefs including accepted backend support commits and the verified rendered runtime. These outputs become UAT inputs unchanged. Submit the exact response to the coordinator gate; never self-advance. Create the scoped local commit under the existing implementation authority after required checks pass, read back full SHA and committed diff, and return per-repository commit references. Preserve unrelated local changes; never stage everything, bypass hooks, push or invent an empty commit. If no code changed, return the verified existing commit and explain no change. Missing commit proof prevents a passing delivery. Always write E/flows.json as the ready UAT handoff, even outside a named workflow; preserve accepted journey order and expected results, bind source paths, real commits and the observed served build. Validate with validateFEHandoff against the selected accepted journeys before delivery. When selected in a job matrix, produce E/job-result.json bound to the exact request, its output schema and every required criterion. This handoff is conditional and does not change standalone or named frontend response contracts. Include assets in E/flows.json and FE outputs alongside flows/codeRefs/runtime; pass the exact manifest to UAT. The assets-accounted-for criterion requires full draw coverage and real ready assets or explicitly allowed decorative deferrals.

requirement.en: Run workspace validation; every cited ID/path exists or is explicitly proposed, required assertions are covered, input bindings are current, and an honest not-run/fail cannot earn done.
Inspect exact staged diff and actual tests; bind full real source commit(s), per repository, and separately retain integration/tested mappings. Report uncommitted or no-change honestly.

The input map names actual applicable knowledge rules/cases; source/render review records observations for each and any draw conflict. Required rule violations or unresolved material conflicts prevent completion; visual similarity never substitutes for compliance.

For selected repairs, the original expected assertion has actual before/after observations and affected collateral checks; preserve unresolved failures. For new work this repair-only proof is explicitly not applicable.

draws is an explicit image-reference array. Every entry was opened and has an observation and screen/state/viewport mapping in draws-review; all required mapped outputs have corresponding inspected render evidence. Missing/unreadable images, unreviewed entries, unresolved alternatives and required coverage gaps cannot earn done. A declared no-draw scope records an empty array honestly.

Every selected accepted draw asset was actually opened and its identity/revision mapped to business ACs, architecture/API/state contracts and source. Missing or conflicting required inputs remain blockers; absent unselected draw is explicit.

Actual implemented surface screenshot is retained, visually inspected and compared with selected accepted draw inputs; deviations and affected rechecks are recorded; code-only delivery is explicitly partial when this required capture cannot be made.

This implement op owns lint, typecheck, relevant tests/coverage, affected builds and Sonar. Resolve real repository scripts and CI thresholds; record command, source tree/commit, result and sanitized logs. For Sonar record the analysis/revision and actual server quality-gate result after processing; scanner submission alone is not pass. Fix scoped failures and rerun affected checks. A missing runner, token reference, coverage target or unavailable required Sonar gate is blocked/not-run, never pass; do not move this responsibility to architecture, business or UAT. Reuse existing authorization and keep secrets outside evidence.

Every draw is inventoried; each selected asset is actually reused/generated and rendered or explicitly deferred as permitted for Claude. Ready assets have actual retained image bytes and source paths. Deferred decorative slots have concrete briefs; functional assets cannot pass while missing.

condition.en: draws is missing when required, is not an array, contains unreadable image references, or is empty without an explicit no-draw scope. Name the affected entries.
Required screen/state/viewport coverage, approval or the relationship between images cannot be resolved; report exact image entries and the missing decision.
Accepted draw intent conflicts with applicable knowledge and cannot be reconciled within the selected scope; identify the asset/region, actual rule/case and owner decision required.
A selected accepted draw asset cannot be opened or conflicts with required business/architecture inputs; report the exact source and decision needed.
Required business state, action API or component ownership is unresolved.
No permitted runtime can prove the implemented surface/build; do not fabricate a screenshot.

A declared prerequisite is not effectively done, or a required declared input/scope is missing. Report node/resource IDs and propose a separately selected graph update when needed; never run predecessors or weaken dependsOn/refs/required to proceed.

placeholders.repo-id: Resolved direct repository name or path
